A.basis: Neuron dynamics and models are treated as an algorithmic topic.

B.basis: Spike-train representation and temporal encoding are explicit algorithmic topics.

C.basis: Local, conversion-assisted, and gradient-based learning are surveyed.

D.basis: ANN-to-SNN conversion is a named route.

E.basis: APIs and libraries are reviewed without a deployment-fidelity comparison.

F.basis: Hardware requirements are related to platforms but compilers and mappers are not systematically compared.

G.basis: No interchange representation or cross-framework IR taxonomy was identified.

H.basis: The paper surveys named neuromorphic architectures and device technologies.

I.basis: No taxonomy of semantic failures across deployment boundaries was identified.

J.basis: No literature-wide physical, simulated, and proxy evidence classification was identified.

K.basis: Applications illustrate algorithms and hardware but are not normalized as a measured-results registry.

L.basis: No complete reproducible trained-network-to-named-chip route was identified.

surveys.deployment_depth: Inventories hardware and applications but does not provide a fixed, reproducible deployment route.
